correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | 40 cells reported unsupported by the adapter's supported(), listed in correctness.unsupported_cells | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, nodes gb200-nvl4-ts2-99

low_level: Registers 29 to 188 over the 120 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (2 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 48 to 32832 bytes, harness 0.10 on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99.
Adapter statics: input arrangement striped, output indices, temp storage 1 to 1 bytes.
Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, 40 cells unsupported by the adapter's contract or the device, no cell failed the oracle.
algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99): latency not_guaranteed wins 3 of 11 cells (runner-up in 1), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 3 of 6 cells (runner-up in 0), throughput not_guaranteed wins 3 of 11 cells (runner-up in 4), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 3 of 6 cells (runner-up in 2).
Where it wins on random input (fp32 N 32, fp32 N 128), the median margin over the runner-up is +26 percent and over the scope's reference control +78 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): fp32 N 32 k 2 +203 percent behind W2_packed_sw_v2@T8 in throughput not_guaranteed, fp32 N 32 k 4 +136 percent behind W2_packed_sw_v2@T8 in throughput prefer_smaller_index, fp32 N 128 k 4 +101 percent behind W2_packed_sw_v2@T16 in latency not_guaranteed, fp32 N 64 k 4 +84 percent behind W2_packed_sw_v2@T16 in latency not_guaranteed.
negative: The GB200 pass measured random input only on one host (gb200-nvl4-ts2-99): the tie_heavy, shuffled-tie and phase 3b order-check findings for this adapter are on its B200 card.
surprises: None beyond what the tables show.
open_questions: B200 pass (WINNERS_b200.md, random input on umbriel-b200-047, tie_heavy on 068, shuffled ties on 094, phase 3b on 047): the warp and sub-warp winners agree with GB200 on 359 of 376 common cells (365 of 376 when each cell is compared through the adapters both passes measured, as section 16 of the knowledge base does), the differences are named sub-warp lane-count cells, N 128 sub-warp throughput cells and warp ties within 5 percent, and in the block matrices the B1_idx against B1_det2 throughput ties fall either way. On GB200 the k 64 cells at 128 threads run 3 to 15 percent slower than on B200 (hw-researcher, a generation property) and the aarch64 cicc emits branches for the conditional swaps (T20, 3 to 4 percent).
